name: Route 5 & Underground Path
summary: Traveling south from Cerulean City through Route 5. Saffron City's northern gate is blocked by thirsty guards, requiring passage through the Underground Path directly to Route 6.

items.name: Destiny Knot
items.method: On the table in the back room of the Pokémon Day Care

items.name: Revive
items.method: By the tall grass north of the Underground Path entrance

items.name: Lava Cookie
items.method: Given by Socialite Mathilda after defeat

items.name: Full Incense
items.method: Upstairs table in the Pokémon Day Care (random incense roll)

navigation_notes: The Saffron City gatekeeper demands a drink and will not permit entry. Enter the Underground Path building to bypass Saffron and proceed directly to Route 6. Pick up the Destiny Knot inside the Day Care for future breeding.
